question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be attained together
Great accomplishment arises from such attainment
The yoginīs favor one with this accomplishment
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs through great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation.
